body:
A little background, I was 15 at the time, and had experiences with weed, dmt, shrooms, molly, alcohol, and codeine. This was by far the most frightening and eyeopening experience I have ever had.
It was a cold winter day, and me and my friend M were looking to get high any way we could. He suggested he get some legal at a local smoke shop so he picked up a package
with 3 stars on the back of the package. We arrived at one of his acquaintances house, I had never met the kid before in my life. We sit on his couch and I immediately pack a bong of the stuff. I cashed the bowl in one hit, it was a 1 gram bowlhead.
My heartrate immediately began to pound and my vision began to blur. I also began to laugh hysterically and I didn't know why. I was nervous because I didn't want to make a fool out of myself. Time began to warp and everything went black. next thing I know is that I am on a neon outlined baseball field and my friend is asking if I'm cool. I say yes but I continue to fall into a psychedelic nightmare. I than become disconnected to my body and I believe I'm dead. I see nothing but blackness and it begins to become harder for me to breathe. I than start convulsing and I start to have a mild seizure. My friend decides not to call 911 and to wait it out.
I finally come back to reality after what seemed to be hours but only was 20 minutes. It took another 10 minutes for me to come back to baseline.
I would not do it!
